context: Add a push trigger for develop so merged state is verified, then make the Chromium result gate merges, either by adding its context to the develop ruleset or by folding it into the ci-required-result aggregate. Sequence this only after the suite is green, or develop becomes unmergeable.
description: The job named 'Chromium (full suite, blocking)' is blocking in name only. Verified 2026-08-03: develop has no legacy branch protection, and ruleset develop-squash-only (id 15611785) requires exactly one status context, ci-required-result, which is produced by pr.yml and does not aggregate the browser workflow. PR #1482 merged at 12:49Z with its Chromium job red. Separately, results-explorer-browser.yml triggers only on push to release and pull_request to release or develop, so gh run list --workflow=results-explorer-browser.yml --branch develop returns an empty list: the merged state of develop has never been browser-tested at all.

preserves.behavior: Chromium is only made required once the suite is green, so develop is never left unmergeable
Firefox and WebKit remain independently assessed and are not silently promoted by this change
The job name stops claiming blocking unless the gate genuinely blocks

verifications.description: Chromium is a required context on the live develop ruleset
verifications.expected: Exits 1 on the unfixed tree, where the develop ruleset requires only ci-required-result, and exits 0 once the Chromium gate is genuinely required. Verified failing 2026-08-03.

verifications.description: Browser workflow gate contract test passes
verifications.expected: Exits 1 on the unfixed tree until the develop push trigger and gate wiring are asserted by a test, and exits 0 once both hold.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --grep-invert @performance
verifications.description: Full Chromium suite is green before the gate is enforced
verifications.expected: Zero failures and zero did-not-run entries

work_units.evidence: Added develop to the browser workflow push trigger (PR #1503). The lane previously ran only on PRs into develop, so a squash-merge commit no PR exercised could leave develop silently red.
work_units.summary: Add a push trigger for develop to the browser workflow

work_units.evidence: tests/unit/workflows/test_results_explorer_browser_gate.py: 6 tests pinning develop push+PR triggers, Chromium not continue-on-error while its name claims blocking, Firefox/WebKit stay advisory so Chromium promotion cannot drag them along, and the job still runs the test:e2e:chromium entrypoint (a bare playwright test would drop the --retries=0 cold-load guard). Falsified against the pre-change workflow: 'browser lane does not run on develop pushes: [release]'. Gotcha: PyYAML resolves unquoted 'on:' to boolean True, so a naive workflow['on'] passes vacuously.
work_units.summary: Add a workflow contract test for the trigger and gate wiring

work_units.evidence: Workflow-local half landed: #1503 (develop trigger + contract tests) merged; #1504 adds the 'Results Explorer browser gate' umbrella job, the admin-runbook context record, and the ruleset drift expectations. The live ruleset change is deliberately NOT applied yet - verified that develop does not yet expose the gate job (absent from PR #1501's 22 checks), so adding the required context now would block every open PR on a check nothing reports. Apply after #1504 merges.
work_units.summary: Make Chromium a required context once the suite is green
